tasks.short: Apply precision agriculture information to reduce farming's environmental impacts

steps.what: Collect and verify the actual field boundaries, soil and terrain evidence, current practice and environmental management objective
inputs: Actual farmer information and existing field observations and geospatial records
Existing agricultural GIS and field management system, defined as OTHER
outputs: Actual verified source layers, field conditions and captured environmental objective

steps.what: Determine the actual environmental management zones and constraints with the farmer and capture the exact selected spatial rules
inputs: Actual verified field evidence and objective from s1
outputs: Human-selected field management choices and explicit spatial rules with reasons and limits

steps.what: Build the exact selected environmental management zones in native GIS using the verified layers and explicit spatial rules
inputs: Actual source layers verified in s1
Exact selected zones, units and rules captured in s2
outputs: Draft source-linked field management map with gaps and conflicts exposed

steps.what: Write the actual environmental management explanation and check the entire final map, field identity, zones, constraints and intended farmer recipient
inputs: Actual map from s3, human choices and original field evidence
outputs: Exact complete checked management map and explanation with actual validity limits and recipient

steps.what: Save the exact checked environmental management map and explanation
inputs: Exact complete final artefact checked in s4
outputs: Saved actual environmental management information

steps.what: Send the exact checked management map and explanation to the selected farmer
inputs: Exact final map, explanation and farmer recipient checked in s4
outputs: Actual management information sent with delivery result

steps.what: Check actual implementation information with the farmer and field evidence and assess whether the environmental management choices need revision
inputs: Actual farmer implementation information and available field observations
Issued management information from s6
outputs: Human follow-up assessment and identified evidence gaps or necessary revisions

tasks.design: Configure native {OTHER} GIS operations for exact field management zones chosen by the technician with the farmer. Retain actual environmental reasoning, field verification, full final map and explanation checking, separate save and issue, and actual implementation follow-up.
tasks.previous_blocker: An actual environmental field-management map can require repeated manual spatial construction after management choices are made.
tasks.enabler_now: Native GIS rules can reproduce explicit selected zones from verified field layers.
tasks.still_hard: A map cannot establish actual environmental effects without field context and implementation evidence.
tasks.human_edge: Choose a workable management change and question whether it was implemented and helped the actual field.

ambition.what: Improve existing environmental management map preparation.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native agricultural GIS can construct explicit field zones from verified spatial data, while environmental suitability and actual effects require field assessment.

assumptions: This representative episode applies precision information to actual field-management zoning and follow-up. Shares are unmeasured, not based on the supplied prior, and cannot represent the entire broad duty without observing its actual mix.

Existing survey and field data production remains baseline work; the technician collects, verifies and captures all selected layers in s1 and management rules in s2. Missing boundaries, conditions or rules require retained manual resolution, not inferred maps.
Try native GIS first. Already configured zones, maps and unattended runtime are baseline. Only actual manual spatial construction is replaced.

The technician has ordinary authority to issue this management advice. Any required owner approval must review the complete final artefact and its actual labour must be added. Changed fields or advice invalidate gates; save earns no saving.

The farmer's actual implementation work remains unchanged and is not claimed as saving or transferred free new labour. Actual implementation evidence collection and assessment stay in s7; no free clean monitoring feed or measured environmental benefit is claimed.

No applicator upload, chemical instruction change, tractor control or hidden revised map commit occurs. Actual revisions return through preparation and final checking, and any physical operation requires its own current-state gate and action.
unknowns: Actual environmental planning workflow and manual map construction effort
research_questions: Which spatial operations are manually repeated, and what actual field evidence is used to check implementation?

already_counted.description: Actual field evidence, management choices, complete final explanation and map check and implementation follow-up remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain spatial rule mappings and test field-boundary and source-version exceptions.

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete environmental map and explanation checked in s4; changed data or wording invalidate the check.
Exact final environmental map, explanation and farmer recipient checked in s4; changes require renewed checking.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=80; gross saving=20 from actual manual spatial construction. Deduct 3 incremental hours once for net 17. No gain is claimed for field implementation, environmental outcome, saves or existing maps.

Existing agricultural GIS application, defined as OTHER
outputs: Prepared actual demonstration source material and understood audience need

inputs: Actual selected dataset and demonstration material from s1
outputs: Actual checked demonstration view and known limitations

steps.what: Demonstrate the actual GIS applications live and explain what the geospatial layers and calculations do and do not show
inputs: Actual checked demonstration view and audience
outputs: Actual live demonstration and explanation

steps.what: Answer actual audience questions and clarify how the geospatial application relates to their real work
inputs: Actual questions following the live demonstration
outputs: Human answers, clarified limits and unresolved questions

Native views are tried first; existing efficient navigation is baseline. No synthetic field dataset or generated technical claim is assumed.

steps.what: Complete and check the entire final actual map against source coordinates, extent, scale, contour or soil rules, labels and uncertainty

Original actual source evidence

tasks.design: Configure native {OTHER} GIS import and exact map drawing rules from actual selected sources. Keep source verification, map reading, interpretation and the complete final map check human before saving.

tasks.short: Recommend crop varieties or seeding rates for specific field areas

steps.what: Gather and verify actual field-area geospatial data, soil and yield evidence, crop options and farmer objectives, capturing explicit comparison rules
inputs: Actual field datasets, farmer information and current crop option sources
Existing agricultural GIS and field analysis system, defined as OTHER
outputs: Actual verified selected field records, options, units and explicit comparison calculations

steps.what: Join exact selected data to field areas and calculate the technician-selected descriptive area comparisons in native GIS
inputs: Actual selected records, explicit area keys and calculation rules captured in s1
outputs: Draft source-linked area comparison tables and maps with missing matches visible

steps.what: Analyse the actual area comparisons and determine suitable crop varieties or seeding rates with reasons and limits for each specific area
inputs: Actual area comparisons and original field evidence
Actual crop option evidence and farmer objectives from s1
outputs: Human-selected specific recommendations, rationale and uncertainty

steps.what: Write the actual recommendation and check its entire final field areas, varieties or rates, units, evidence, limits and farmer recipient
inputs: Actual human recommendations from s3 and original sources
outputs: Exact complete checked final recommendation and selected recipient

steps.what: Save the exact checked crop or seeding-rate recommendation
inputs: Exact complete final recommendation checked in s4
outputs: Saved actual field-area recommendation

steps.what: Send the exact checked recommendation to the selected farmer
inputs: Exact final recommendation and recipient checked in s4
outputs: Actual recommendation sent with delivery result

tasks.design: Configure native {OTHER} GIS joins and explicit area comparisons from actual verified field data. Keep crop and seeding-rate judgement, substantive recommendation writing and the complete final check human in {DOCS}, followed by separate save and farmer send.

Existing source collection remains baseline work. The technician gathers and verifies actual sources, captures area keys and selects exact comparison rules in s1. No free clean field feed, crop response model or inferred rate is assumed.
Use native GIS first; existing joins and calculations are baseline and earn no new gain. Missing areas and unmatched or incompatible records remain visible for retained human resolution.

All actual variety and rate selection and full recommendation writing and checking remain in s3-s4. The technician has ordinary authority for this advice; any required owner review must examine the complete final version and its real effort must be added.

The final recommendation exists before its gate; changed data, rates or recipient invalidate it. Save is negligible and earns no gain. No controller upload, seed order, sowing action or guaranteed yield improvement is implied by sending advice.
